Zephyr 4.1 modules/Kconfig.tinycrypt:9-12 has config TINYCRYPT 'select DEPRECATED', and 4.1's scripts/kconfig/kconfig.py check_deprecated() aborts configure on ANY warning with no per-symbol suppress knob and no CONFIG_WARN_TO_ERROR symbol (4.1 removed it). LICHEN selects TINYCRYPT from subsys/lichen/crypto/Kconfig:9, subsys/lichen/edhoc/Kconfig:8, subsys/lichen/gateway/Kconfig:8 (tunnel_auth.c includes tinycrypt/sha256.h under __ZEPHYR__; edhoc/oscore use tinycrypt AES_CCM/HMAC). So every Zephyr build enabling those modules fails configure on 4.1, including the native_sim gateway validation target. NOTE: edhoc/oscore crypto internals are human-only edit bar - the migration design (PSA crypto? mbedTLS? keep tinycrypt via a zephyr fork patch?) is a Mark decision. Options: (a) migrate tunnel_auth SHA256 to a non-deprecated provider and drop LICHEN_GATEWAY's select (smallest surface; edhoc/oscore stay on tinycrypt until their own migration), (b) tree-wide tinycrypt replacement, (c) carry a zephyr downstream patch removing the select DEPRECATED. Repro after jy0a fixes: west build -b native_sim/native/64 lichen/apps/gateway on heft -\u003e single remaining warning 'Deprecated symbol TINYCRYPT is enabled' -\u003e abort.
